items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: Danny Lewis came in the Eagle Band later on after Bob Lyne left.

ctx.x: Well, if I can recall at that time, I can call some of the guys, I think. Bob Lyne, you know, Bob Lyne was an Eagle Band all these days, most of all these days. Frankie Deuce and they had Chiff on trumpet. I think they had Lil' Warnick on the clarinet. And Danny Lewis on. No, it wasn't Danny Lewis. Danny Lewis came in the Eagle Band later on after Bob Lyne left. Now, who was the drummer? I can't recall. I don't know if it was Hennerzine or Hennerzine. I don't know, I can't recall who was the drummer. Guitar?

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Danny Lewis on bass drum, well, they used them sometimes.

ctx.x: They don't have no musicians. No, shame on them.

You should hear those bands in those days, like the Olympia band, Superior band, and Imperial band, those was bands. And the parade, does he like the Armand Brass band? I mean, well, the Armand Brass band, I mean, they played my father, I mean, he can't tell you about that, because you didn't ask him about that. But I can tell you, they played ball house music. You can forget about what he said about the other fellas, you know, reading at that time. Yeah, but later on in the years, I mean, it was a Ball House…
Who were the Ball House men in that band?
